name: Classic Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
instructions: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente, reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Thinly slice 6 cloves of garlic.
Heat 1/3 cup olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic slices and red chili flakes, cook gently 2-3 minutes until golden.
Add drained pasta and a splash of pasta water, toss vigorously.
Season with salt and black pepper, garnish with fresh parsley.
tips: Do not burn the garlic — golden, not brown. Reserve pasta water for a silky sauce.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Use day-old cold rice for best results.
Heat oil in a wok or large pan over high heat.
Scramble 2 eggs, set aside.
Sauté diced onion, garlic, and carrots until softened (3 mins).
Add peas and cook 1 more minute.
Add cold rice, breaking clumps, stir-fry 3-4 minutes.
Return eggs, add soy sauce and sesame oil, toss everything together.
Garnish with spring onions.
tips: High heat is key. Day-old rice prevents clumping. Add more soy sauce to taste.

substitutions.sesame oil: skip or use a few drops of olive oil

name: Chicken Stir-Fry with Vegetables
instructions: Slice chicken thinly, marinate with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp cornstarch for 10 mins.
Cut all vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Heat oil in wok over high heat; cook chicken until golden (4-5 mins), set aside.
In same wok, stir-fry garlic and ginger 30 seconds.
Add carrots, broccoli, bell pepper; stir-fry 3-4 mins.
Return chicken, add oyster sauce, soy sauce, and 2 tbsp water.
Toss well, drizzle sesame oil before serving.
tips: Velvet chicken with cornstarch for tenderness. Keep everything moving in the wok.

substitutions.oyster sauce: hoisin sauce or extra soy sauce

name: Tomato Basil Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente.
Meanwhile, sauté 3 minced garlic cloves in olive oil for 1 minute.
Add chopped fresh tomatoes (or canned), simmer 10-12 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper, and a pinch of sugar to balance acidity.
Toss pasta in sauce, top with fresh basil and grated parmesan.
tips: Fresh tomatoes yield sweeter sauce; canned diced tomatoes are a great substitute.

name: Lentil Soup
instructions: Rinse 1.5 cups red lentils thoroughly.
Sauté diced onion in olive oil until soft (5 mins).
Add minced garlic, cumin, turmeric, and coriander, cook 1 minute.
Add carrots (diced), tomatoes, lentils, and 4 cups vegetable stock.
Bring to boil, reduce heat, simmer 25 minutes until lentils are soft.
Blend half the soup for a creamy texture (optional).
Squeeze in lemon juice, adjust seasoning.
tips: Red lentils dissolve naturally — no soaking needed. Lemon brightens the flavor enormously.

substitutions.red lentils: green or brown lentils (add 10 more mins)

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
instructions: Mash 2 ripe bananas in a bowl.
Whisk in 2 eggs, 1/4 cup milk, 1 tsp vanilla extract.
Stir in 1 cup oats, 1 tsp baking powder, pinch of salt.
Let batter rest 2 minutes.
Cook on buttered non-stick pan over medium heat, 2-3 mins per side.
Serve with honey, maple syrup, or fresh fruit.
tips: Very ripe bananas are sweeter and mash more easily. Oats soak up liquid — don't over-thin the batter.

substitutions.milk: almond milk, oat milk, or water
substitutions.eggs: flax egg (1 tbsp ground flax + 3 tbsp water)

name: Egg Bhurji (Indian Scrambled Eggs)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add finely chopped onion, sauté until golden.
Add minced garlic, ginger, green chili, cook 1 minute.
Add chopped tomato, turmeric, coriander powder, salt; cook until oil separates (3 mins).
Beat 4 eggs and pour over the masala.
Scramble gently until just set.
Garnish with fresh cilantro. Serve with toast or roti.
tips: Don't overcook eggs — remove from heat while still slightly soft.

name: Chickpea Curry (Chana Masala)
instructions: Heat oil, sauté diced onion until golden (6-7 mins).
Add minced garlic and ginger, cook 2 minutes.
Add all dry spices (cumin, coriander, turmeric, chili powder), stir 30 seconds.
Add chopped tomatoes, cook until they break down into a thick paste (8 mins).
Add drained chickpeas and 1 cup water.
Simmer 15 minutes, partially mashing a few chickpeas for thickness.
Finish with garam masala and fresh cilantro.
Serve with rice or naan.
tips: Canned chickpeas work perfectly here. Longer simmering = richer flavor.

name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
instructions: Toast bread slices until golden.
Halve avocado, remove pit, scoop flesh into a bowl.
Mash with lemon juice, salt, pepper.
Bring water to a gentle simmer, add a splash of vinegar.
Crack egg into a small cup, swirl water and slide egg in; poach 3 mins.
Spread avocado on toast, top with poached egg.
Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle chili flakes.
tips: Very fresh eggs poach better. Don't skip vinegar in water — it keeps whites together.

substitutions.lemon juice: lime juice or apple cider vinegar
substitutions.bread: sourdough, whole wheat, or gluten-free bread

name: Garlic Butter Mushroom Rice
instructions: Rinse rice and set aside.
Melt butter in a pot over medium heat; sauté diced onion 3 mins.
Add sliced mushrooms, cook until browned (5 mins).
Add minced garlic and thyme, cook 1 minute.
Add rice and stir to coat with butter.
Pour in vegetable stock (2:1 ratio to rice), season with salt and pepper.
Bring to boil, cover and simmer 15-18 mins until rice is cooked.
Fluff with fork, garnish with parsley.
tips: Let mushrooms brown properly without stirring for maximum flavor.

name: Spinach and Cheese Omelette
instructions: Whisk 3 eggs with 2 tbsp milk, salt, and pepper.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour in egg mixture, let it set at the edges.
Add wilted spinach and grated cheese to one half.
Fold omelette over the filling.
Cook 1 more minute, slide onto plate.
tips: Low-medium heat ensures a soft, non-rubbery omelette. Add filling when eggs are 80% set.

name: Black Bean Tacos
instructions: Drain and rinse black beans.
Sauté onion in oil until soft; add garlic, cumin, chili powder.
Add black beans, 2 tbsp water, salt; mash lightly and cook 5 mins.
Dice tomato and avocado; mix with lime juice, cilantro, salt for quick salsa.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill tortillas with bean mixture and top with salsa.
tips: Toast cumin in dry pan before adding for deeper flavor.

name: Creamy Potato Soup
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
Sauté onion and garlic in butter until soft.
Add potatoes and vegetable stock; bring to boil.
Simmer 15-20 mins until potatoes are fork-tender.
Mash or blend until desired consistency.
Stir in milk and grated cheddar until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper, top with chives.
tips: Starchy potatoes like Russet make a creamier soup. Reserve some potato chunks for texture.

substitutions.milk: heavy cream for richer soup or plant-based milk

name: Honey Garlic Salmon
instructions: Pat salmon dry, season with salt and pepper.
Mix honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, and lemon juice for glaze.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear salmon skin-side up for 4 minutes until golden.
Flip, pour glaze over salmon.
Transfer to 200°C (400°F) oven, bake 6-8 minutes until cooked through.
Spoon pan juices over salmon, garnish with parsley.
tips: Don't move salmon while searing — let it release naturally. Internal temp should reach 63°C (145°F).

name: Veggie Omelette Rice (Omurice)
instructions: Sauté diced onion and carrot in butter until soft.
Add peas and cooked rice, stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add ketchup and soy sauce, toss well until rice is coated. Set aside.
Beat 2 eggs per serving with a pinch of salt.
Make a thin omelette in buttered pan.
Place rice in center of omelette, fold over or wrap.
Top with extra ketchup.
tips: Rice should be warmed through before wrapping. Work quickly when folding the omelette.

substitutions.ketchup: tomato sauce with a pinch of sugar
